title: Lift draft on green CI
summary: Marks a draft pull request ready for review once its CI run is green, and does nothing else: no merge, no checkout. For a repository that opens pull requests as drafts and does not install auto-merge, which already lifts the draft.

CI_WORKFLOW.prompt: Name of the CI workflow that must be green before a merge (its `name:`)

postInstall: The CI workflow (the name given at install, "CI" by default) must exist under that exact `name:` and run on pull_request. A pull request CI does not run on — documentation only, where CI skips it — keeps its draft: lift it by hand.

Do not install this module with auto-merge, which lifts the draft itself. From now on a draft means "CI has not signed off": an author still at work on a pull request labels it session-active (create the label once: gh label create session-active). Say so to whoever opens pull requests here.
The workflow acts once it is on the default branch. Open a draft pull request then and watch the draft lifted when CI turns green.
